name: Shiori
message: "I wonder if Ms. Librarian has any new information about the case."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go see her."

name: Shiori
message: "—Or so I'd like to say, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Look, over there. On the bench."

name: Shiori
message: "If I'm not mistaken... that's Tetsuya-san, isn't it?"

name: Shiori
message: "We should relay Ms. Librarian's message to him. We don't know when we'll see him next, after all."

name: Shiori
message: "It looks like he really can't see me. Could you talk to him instead?"
I should try talking to him.
"Hello."

name: Elderly Man
message: "...Huh? Ah, hello."

name: Elderly Man
message: "Sorry about last time—for asking you such a weird question out of nowhere. I don't know what came over me."
"Are you Tetsuya-san?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "That's... right. Why...?"
"I have a message from Tomoko-san."
"What became of your novel?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "H-How did you know about that—"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I see... So Tomoko-san... really is there..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And she still remembers me..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I... How do I even put this into words?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'm pathetic. I've spent years regretting how I ran away, and yet now that I finally have the chance to explain things properly to her, I..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Could you give me a little time?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "Too much time has passed."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I need to sort my feelings out."

name: Tetsuya
message: "...I'm sorry. I'll... come see you again."

name: Shiori
message: "And there he goes..."

name: Shiori
message: "Did he not answer because he was guilty about something?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Either way, we shouldn't tell Ms. Librarian yet. I mean, how could we? He didn't give an answer."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmm, he did say he needed time... We should wait until he's ready."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hello. You've arrived. Please, have a seat."
(Take a seat)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I've looked into the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. What did you find?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Perhaps it's more accurate to say that I couldn't fully investigate it. It's rather puzzling."

name: Shiori
message: "Meaning?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Five people died in such a short period, and all the bodies were dumped in relatively inconspicuous places—like bushes in parks."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Because the culprit was so sloppy in covering their tracks, people assumed they'd be caught quickly."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Every newspaper at the time covered the investigation, day and night—however..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "From one particular day onward, all coverage suddenly stopped."

name: Shiori
message: "Same here... We couldn't find any articles online about an arrest and the like."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's normal for coverage to lessen as a case drags on."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "But for all news outlets to stop at the same time is quite strange."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Though, when things fall this silent... something does come to mind."

name: Shiori
message: "And that is?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There was a similar case in this town before, when certain allegations suddenly vanished overnight."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's most likely pressure from someone."

name: Shiori
message: "Pressure... So you're saying the culprit might have been someone in a high position?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Or someone connected to them, though this is only a hypothesis."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems gossip magazines pursued the culprit more actively than the newspapers."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I found one such magazine. Normally, its retention period would have ended, but once it went out of print, it gained archival value. We were fortunate the issues were still here."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "According to the magazine, the suspects had been narrowed down to two."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "One was a certain man. While he was only referred to in the magazine as Y, they were practically naming him outright. Quite an aggressive publication, if I may say."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "This man, Y, was often seen watching little girls at parks, which made parents wary of him."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The other was a certain girl, referred to in the magazine as Girl A. Any information that could identify her personally was withheld, as she was apparently a minor."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "From what we have, we can't even say whether the A is an initial."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Girl A was seen walking hand in hand with the victim. She seems even more suspicious than Y."

name: Shiori
message: "Man Y... and Girl A..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Are you perhaps worried that it might be you?"

name: Shiori
message: "I feel like... I might be connected to the case."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll admit I got anxious, thinking... what if it was me?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If I may be direct, Girl A was described as a high school student."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Or more precisely, a girl believed to be one, based on her uniform."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... a high school student..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And I'm aware this may be presumptuous of me, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Hm?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You don't strike me as someone who'd commit a crime."

name: Shiori
message: "...Thank you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Let us return to the subject. The suspects were Man Y and Girl A, just those two."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Whether one of them acted alone, or the two were accomplices..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I personally lean toward the latter, but I should refrain from saying more."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Despite narrowing the suspects down that far, no arrest was ever made. That is the objective fact."

name: Shiori
message: "Then is it possible that they were both innocent?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Quite possible. However... the sudden cessation of all coverage remains troubling."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I will revisit this matter myself, once I have cleared my head."

name: Shiori
message: "And the magazine never reported an arrest either?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Correct. Or more accurately, the magazine did not survive long enough to report one."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Pursuing this high-profile case was the magazine's last-ditch attempt to revive itself, and they even published some rather bold articles. However..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Their efforts seem to have been in vain."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Had the series continued, we might have learned more about the culprit, yet if it hadn't gone out of print, the issues wouldn't have been archived."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I can only imagine how frustrating it must've been—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "—especially for those who were pursuing the case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Ah, yes. One more thing. While it doesn't seem related, I should tell you, just in case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There was an article in this morning's paper that caught my attention. It said that a certain man had died under suspicious circumstances."

name: Shiori
message: "A certain man?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes. Do you remember that accident from five years ago?"

name: Shiori
message: "You mean the accident you looked into for me? Don't tell me..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The name sounded familiar, so I checked again. It was a match."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The name of the man who died yesterday matched that of the driver who caused the accident."

name: Shiori
message: "And his death was suspicious?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I don't know the details. As I said, it's probably unrelated to the serial kidnapping murders, so it doesn't seem worth investigating any further."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "However, you did show an interest in the accident from five years ago."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Your memories may not have returned, but I assumed you felt something, which is why you wanted to look into it."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Since I couldn't say for certain that you and the accident were unrelated, I thought it best to tell you."

name: Shiori
message: "The person who caused the accident you had just looked into has just died... and under suspicious circumstances, no less."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please keep it in the back of your mind, just in case. It may turn out to be an unexpected lead."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, I understand."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That is all I can tell you for now. I'll continue looking to see if any other materials on the serial kidnapping murders remain."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. Thank—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Allow me to cut in before you thank me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I've been enjoying the research you requested."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It may be inappropriate to say this when there are victims involved, but I, too, am dead. I believe I can be allowed that much, at least."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Perhaps this could even allow me to settle a personal grudge, of sorts..."

name: Shiori
message: "A grudge?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's nothing."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's just that my days of simply devouring books left and right have become far more stimulating, thanks to you two."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Call it mutual benefit. You don't need to thank me."

name: Shiori
message: "By any chance, are you..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes?"

name: Shiori
message: "Are you the type who's not good at receiving praise and gratitude?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: ".........When confronted so directly, I find myself at a loss for words."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, I do want to thank you again and again, but if you don't like it, I guess it just becomes a nuisance. I'll hold back from now on."

name: Shiori
message: "Again, we're counting on you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Of course. You can count on me."

name: Shiori
message: "Two suspects... Man Y and Girl A..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, sorry. I didn't mean to look so serious."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm okay. It's not as if I truly believe I was the culprit."

name: Shiori
message: "It's just... I considered the possibility, if only briefly."

name: Shiori
message: "However..."

name: Shiori
message: "There's an unease inside me that just won't go away. I'm also feeling... how should I put it? Impatient?"

name: Shiori
message: "It's like I have to learn more about that girl and the case as soon as possible..."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't really understand why I'm this fixated."

name: Shiori
message: "But just thinking about it won't help. I need to do something."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh? You've got a call. Maybe it's Gyaruko-san."
(Answer the phone)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey hey~, it's me~"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, it really was Gyaruko-san."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Where are you right now? I'm about to get to the convenience store."

name: Shiori
message: "In front of the library. We'll head over right away."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yep yep, see ya later~"

name: Shiori
message: "Perfect timing. Let's head to the store now, shall we?"

name: Shiori
message: "They say investigations are built on legwork. Even if the papers or the internet have nothing, someone out there might know something."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, shall we get going?"

name: Shiori
message: "It looks like... he's not back yet. I hope we'll hear his answer soon, though..."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go. We don't want to bother Ms. Librarian by visiting too often."

name: Shiori
message: "We're here, but... I don't think even Ms. Librarian can gather new info in such a short time."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's come back if we hit a dead end."
